title_as_printed: Experimental Heat Capacity of Aqueous KCl Solutions at 200 bar Pressure

footnotes_as_printed.a: The uncertainty of each phi_Cp value was estimated assuming absolute errors of +/-0.00015 in Ps/Pw and relative errors of 1% in delta P/P and in the correction factor, f. (letter a is attached to the column header delta)

pressure_note: All of the present results are for 200 bar (table title: 'at 200 bar Pressure'); no statement whether total or gauge

value.what: apparent molar heat capacity of KCl, calculated by the authors from the measured Ps/Pw (eq 12)

value2.what: specific heat capacity of the solution, calculated by the authors from the measured Ps/Pw and correction factor f

value3.what: raw measured ratio from the flow calorimeter (ratio of power with solution to power with water)

uncertainty.what: estimated uncertainty of phi_Cp, footnote a

composition.other_species: none (KCl in water); molality printed mol kg-1, solutions made up by mass

skip_rows.reason: temperature block labels (T and correction factor f)

notes: Five temperature blocks stacked, label row first. delta column carries header footnote a (not repeated in note column). Table III-XI etc. not extracted (derived).
